All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
Card
Represents a single playing card in the Cincuentazo game.
Deck
Represents a standard 52-card deck used in the Cincuentazo game.
EmptyDeckException
Unchecked exception thrown when an attempt is made to draw a card from an empty deck.
EndController
Controller for the End Game View.

EndStage is a utility class that manages the end-game view and scene.
GameController
JavaFX controller for the main game screen.
GameEngine
Core game engine managing game state and move validation.
GameEventListener
Observer interface for game-state events in Cincuentazo.
GameOverException
Thrown to signal that the Cincuentazo game has ended.
GameStage
GameStage is a utility class that manages the game view and scene.
GameState
Manages the state of the poker game during play.
HumanPlayer
Represents a human-controlled player in the Cincuentazo game.
InvalidMoveException
Thrown to indicate that a player attempted an illegal move in Cincuentazo.
MachinePlayer
Represents an AI-controlled player in the Cincuentazo game.
Main
Main application entry point for the Poker game (50/Juego del 50).
MenuController
JavaFX controller for the main menu screen of Cincuentazo.
MenuStage
MenuStage is a utility class that manages the menu view and scene.
Player
Abstract base class representing a player in the Cincuentazo game.
PlayerStatus
Enumerates the possible activity states of a player during a game.
Rank
Enumerates the thirteen possible ranks of a standard playing card, from TWO through ACE, each carrying a display symbol.
Suit
Enumerates the four suits of a standard playing card deck.
Table
Represents the central table (pile) in the Cincuentazo game.
TurnManager
Manages turn execution and timing in the poker game.
